_about: 守墙关 — wall defense, the 塔防 kit's second level type (Hanli 10-20: 「可否加一个类似这个的关卡, 让塔防多样性」, 「做原型吧」; the reference is 《向僵尸开炮》). Beasts come down the 山道 in waves; 小满 casts from the 山门 wall, 银月 sits beside him; after each wave the player picks 1 of 3 cards (the 守炉 kit as skills). The engine: scripts/games/shouqiang/core.js (pure, seeded, node-testable); the play: scripts/games/shouqiang/shouqiang.min.mjs (Phaser, built from tools/shouqiang/). Board 540×960, y grows down; the wall's face is at `wallY`. Numbers in arrays are per card level (1…max).

beasts._about: hp before the level's hpMul and the wave's growth; speed px/s; bite: wall hp per second at the wall; size: the drawn height px; r: hit radius; armor: damage taken × this per kind (missing = 1); fly: over the burning ground, straight at the wall; frames: the painted ones (art/<id>-<frame>.webp — one walk frame steps by a bob).

hero._about: 小满's flying swords and 银月's spirit bolt: what plays before any card.

jieyin._about: 结印 — the player's spells at the camera, only where a camera is (Hanli 10-21: 「让用户结印发火弹帮忙打怪」, 「没摄像头时, 就不用用户结印帮打」), and a big move, rarely: offered only while a 大妖 is on the field (`when`: boss | elite | always — 「不然打小怪, 结手印太频繁很累」), a long cooldown between casts (`cool` s of game time: the hand is down, the seals are not counted — 「加一个手势的冷却, 让用户大部分时间在休息」), and hard on the 大妖 (`bossMul` — 「手印攻击高, 可以引导玩家用于打boss」). `aim`: with no beast tapped, the 大妖 in reach first. 五行相克 (素问: 木得金而伐，火得水而灭，土得木而达，金得火而缺，水得土而绝): `beats` [spell element → the root it overcomes], × `counter` (a beast's root: creatures.json). `idle`: s ready with no hand raised before the camera closes itself. `armedFps`: the eye's rate while a 小招 is armed (a jab is ~200 ms); `cool`: 守墙关's own rest between casts, over 手势斗法's 灵力 (its refill alone would allow a 小招 every ~2 s). `say`: the cue when the 大妖 steps out. Tests: tests/game-shouqiang-jieyin.test.mjs.

say.en: The great beast is here — make the seals!

first.en: Make the sword seal and the flying sword goes

jieyin._moves: What each 手势斗法 move does here (doc/games.md § 手势斗法; the hands are read by games/jieyin/duel.js — its cast event's `move` is the id). 小招 (a shape + a jab or push: 飞剑 剑诀 · 点穴 单剑指 · 掌风 推掌 · 拳劲 拳) from the start — before 古六 they are all there is (Hanli 10-21: 「古6是系统学习, 前面可以出现简单的, 比如剑诀」, 隔空指点 「很不错, 加进去」); 法术 (the book's five, 文 → 扣 → 推) and the 大招 (the four-seal 火蛋) after 古六's 讲堂 (`from`: any of those marks in the save; the story hands its marks in, `data.marks`; the 游戏厅 gives none → all). shape: one | spear (the line from 小满's hand on through the beast, `width`, `splash`) | row (ground beasts within `width` of its height) | ring (`radius`, `splash`); dmg; root: s held; slow × for s; push: px back up the road (never the 大妖). The element (`wuxing`) is the beast-side 相克 key (creatures.json `root` spelling).

units._about: Lane mode (levels 2–5, the 药园): the talismans the player places on the grid, PvZ's proven numbers mapped onto ours (灵气 = the sun). cost: 灵气; recharge: s before the seed can be used again (startCool: at the level's start); hp: what a beast must chew through (100/s); shoot: a bolt up the lane (every s, dmg, speed px/s, slow × for s); make: 灵气 orbs (first s after placing, every s, amount); bomb: bursts after fuse s on every beast within `radius` lanes either side and `rows` cells up and down. art: unit-<id> (idle), unit-<id>-2 (firing / active / battered); seed-<id> the seed card.

say.zh: 聚起园里的灵气，隔一阵结一颗灵珠。
say.en: Gathers the garden's qi into a spirit orb now and then.
Fires flying swords up its bed.

say.zh: 一堵土墙，兽得一口一口啃。
say.en: A block of earth the beasts must chew through.
Ice shards that slow what they hit.

say.zh: 一声炸雷，四周九格全劈。
say.en: One thunderclap strikes the nine cells round it.

laneBeasts._about: Lane mode's beasts, merged over `beasts` on a 药园 level — PvZ's ratios: 野猪 the basic (270), 狰 the vaulter (500; runs at `speed` until it leaps the first talisman it meets, then walks at `leap.after`), 犰狳 the cone (640 — it is hare-sized; `shell`: the share of hp that is shell, 370 — the hits show small until it cracks), 鬿雀 flies over every talisman (300), 合窳 the giant (3000; chews 1000/s, smashing what it meets). speed px/s below the range line (×`approach` above it; PvZ's ratio: one shooter kills the basic in about half the time it takes to cross the reach); chew: hp/s off a talisman; bite: wall hp/s.

say.zh: 每道剑符一次多放一剑。
say.en: Every sword talisman fires one more sword.
Sharper swords.
Spirit orbs come faster.

say.zh: 土墙更厚，立着的也加厚。
say.en: Thicker walls, the standing ones too.
Harder shards, a deeper slow.
The thunder talisman recharges faster.
75 qi, right now.

say.zh: 小满和银月护住墙根前更远一截。
say.en: Xiaoman and Yinyue guard further out from the wall.
One more flying sword per volley.
Swords pierce through more beasts.

say.zh: 飞剑斩中后一折，横掠去斩下一只。
say.en: A sword that strikes swings on to the next beast.

say.zh: 火符落进兽群，炸开一片。
say.en: A fire talisman bursts in the herd.
The blast leaves the ground burning.
A cold burst slows the herd.
Frozen solid, and hit harder.
Lightning leaps beast to beast.
A sky bolt strikes the toughest.

say.zh: 银月吐狐火，落地烧一团。
say.en: Yinyue spits fox-fire that splashes.

say.zh: 一声长啸，满山的兽都愣住。
say.en: One howl stuns every beast on the road.

opening._about: The opening pick (Hanli 10-20 after playing: 「守墙第一关玩家啥也做不了. 可否上来先选一个基础攻击?」 — 《向僵尸开炮》's starting weapon): after the lead-in and before wave 1, the same 3-card pick offers 小满's main attack. The line chosen is what he casts from the first wave, at level 1 of that line (`gives`: that line's first card at Lv.1): `jian` his flying swords at 剑阵 · 添剑 Lv.1 (two a volley), `huo` the 火符 at huo-blast Lv.1, `lei` the 雷符 at lei-chain Lv.1. He throws swords only on the 剑阵 line or once a 剑阵 card is taken. Balanced so each line wins level 1 for a first-timer (tests/game-shouqiang.test.mjs): the swords alone were the weakest start (a fire or thunder Lv.1 outguns one sword a volley), so the 剑阵 line starts at 添剑 Lv.1, and the 山门's `growth` went 0.28 → 0.35 to take back what a free line gives. The first `lean` between-wave offers lean to the chosen line: the first holds `lean` cards of its family, the next `lean` − 1, … (when that many are open). On every level unless a level says `"opening": false` — the 药园 does: the player sets talismans from the first second there, and 小满 only guards the wall's foot.

say.zh: 一轮两把飞剑，追着兽斩。
say.en: Two flying swords a volley, hunting beasts down.

say.zh: 火符砸进兽群，一炸一片。
say.en: Fire talismans burst a whole bunch at once.
Lightning leaps beast to beast.

lead.zh: 沉鼎观的山门，只剩一道墙。
lead.en: Of Chending Temple's gate, only the wall still stands.

lead.zh: 山道上，黑压压的兽潮涌下来。
lead.en: Down the mountain road a black tide of beasts pours.
Here they come!
Hold the gate!

boss.zh: 合窳来了——它一哭，就打它！
boss.en: The heyu! When it wails, hit it!

title.en: Herb garden watch · the first night

lead.en: The ninth of the tenth month: night watch in the herb garden.

lead.zh: 一畦一畦的灵草，夜里泛着幽光。
lead.en: Bed after bed of spirit herbs glows faintly in the dark.

lead.zh: 点一张符，再点一格畦地，布下去。
lead.en: Tap a talisman, then a patch of bed, to set it.
Here they come!

levels._teach: Moments this level's own line teaches (Hanli 10-21): `huge` is a reaction elsewhere, but here 「每一畦都得有剑！」 says how to hold — never asked of her (games/prefetch.js teaches), always this line.

lane.zh: 野猪下山了——守住中间这一畦。
lane.en: The boars are coming down. Hold the middle bed.

twist.zh: 野猪认准一畦往下拱。那一畦，先放剑符！
twist.en: A boar keeps to its bed. Put a sword talisman in that one!

wave_cleared.zh: 聚灵阵多摆几个，后头好过。
wave_cleared.en: More spirit arrays now, easier later.

huge.zh: 一大波来了，每一畦都得有剑！
huge.en: A big wave. Every bed needs a sword!

title.en: Herb garden watch · the second night

lead.zh: 第二夜。墙角的石头上，挂着一撮赤红的毛。
lead.en: The second night. A tuft of red fur hangs on a corner stone.

lead.zh: 狰会跳——它跳过头一道符。
lead.en: The zheng leaps — over the first talisman it meets.
Here they come!

twist.zh: 狰！它会跳过头一道符——前头垫一块土墙给它跳。
twist.en: A zheng! It leaps the first talisman: give it an earth wall to leap.

wave_cleared.zh: 土墙放前头，剑符躲后头。

win.en: Not even the zheng got a bite.

title.en: Herb garden watch · the third night

lead.zh: 第三夜。园子西头，「咔、咔」，像敲石头。
lead.en: The third night. At the west end, a click-clack like knocking stones.

lead.zh: 犰狳披着一身硬壳，剑砍上去只溅火星。
lead.en: The qiuyu wears a hard shell: swords only strike sparks off it.
Here they come!

twist.zh: 犰狳壳硬，一时砍不动。寒符冻慢它，多砍几剑！
twist.en: The qiuyu's shell is hard. Slow it with frost and get more swords in!

wave_cleared.en: Once the shell cracks, it's soft.

win.zh: 壳再硬，也是一畦一畦地倒。
win.en: Hard shells, and still they fell bed by bed.

title.en: Herb garden watch · the night of the heyu

lead.zh: 月底前最后一夜。天上有翅膀扑棱的声音。
lead.en: The last night before the month's end. Wings beat overhead.

lead.zh: 鬿雀从符上飞过去，只有剑够得着它。
lead.en: The qique flies over talismans: only swords can reach it.

lead.zh: 后山深处，有个娃娃在哭……
lead.en: Deep on the back hill, something cries like a baby…
Here they come!

twist.zh: 鬿雀飞过土墙！靠剑符打下来。
twist.en: The qique flies over walls! Shoot it down with swords.

wave_cleared.zh: 雷符留着，等它们挤成一堆。
wave_cleared.en: Save the thunder for when they bunch up.

boss.zh: 合窳！它踩到哪道符，哪道符就碎——用雷符！
boss.en: The heyu! It smashes whatever it steps on. Use thunder!

win.en: Month's end, and not one herb short.

title.en: The beast tide · the first night

lead.zh: 天快黑了，山道上黑压压一片。
lead.en: Dusk is coming on; the mountain road is black with beasts.
Here they come!
Hold the gate!

title.en: The beast tide · the zheng pack

lead.zh: 天黑下来，红毛团子一群一群下山来。
lead.en: Dark falls, and balls of red fur come tumbling downhill in packs.
Here they come!
Hold the gate!

title.en: The beast tide · the whole mountain

lead.en: Every beast on the mountain is coming down.
Here they come!
Hold the gate!

title.en: The beast tide · the hard shells

lead.zh: 犰狳也来了，一身的硬壳。剑砍不进，火烧得透。
lead.en: The qiuyu come too, all hard shell. Swords glance off; fire gets through.
Here they come!
Hold the gate!

levels._story: The 调息 cut (2026-10-20, Hanli: 「调息感觉太多了」 → 「可以」): 09-furnace's board (was 气走经脉 · 定风), task furnace-ding. A story level: `story` names its scene, so 兽潮 (rules/shouchao.mjs tideRows) never serves it, the 游戏厅 lists it off the ladder and it names no 下一关. 野猪 and 狰 only (犰狳 first comes at 09-lingcao, the next scene). Human-like bot 37/40, sharp 22/24, lazy 0/6.

lead.zh: 好容易熬到开了春，药园开了园。巡夜令还挂在你腰上——「园里少一株，戒律堂头一个问你。」
lead.en: At last it was spring, and the herb garden opened. The night-watch token still hangs at your belt: "One herb missing, and the Discipline Hall asks you first."

lead.zh: 饿了一冬的野猪下山拱新芽，狰又跳上了墙头。
lead.en: Boars hungry from the winter come down to root at the new shoots, and a zheng is back on the wall.
Here they come!

twist.zh: 狰！它跳过头一道符——前头垫一块土墙。
twist.en: A zheng! It leaps the first talisman: put an earth wall in front.

win.en: Dawn, and not one herb missing.
